subject.title: feat(agents): inject Recently Completed Subagents into parent prompt

question: Should parent-agent system prompts retain completed child-run metadata by default for 120 minutes, rather than relying only on completion events and the existing active-run block?
rationale: This is a new default orchestration policy with prompt-size and model-behavior consequences; source and unit tests establish implementation shape but cannot choose the intended product tradeoff.

options.title: Accept bounded completion anchors
options.body: Keep the feature with a maintainer-approved fixed retention window and require live proof for successful, failed, and timed-out child outcomes.

options.title: Keep completion context event-only
options.body: Reject persistent completed-run prompt injection and retain the existing completion-event plus on-demand status model.

options.title: Narrow the retained data
options.body: Retain only minimal terminal identifiers and statuses if the full task and label payload is too costly or behaviorally broad.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded completion anchors
recommendation.body: Keep the feature with a maintainer-approved fixed retention window and require live proof for successful, failed, and timed-out child outcomes.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely core routing candidate for an agents prompt-policy decision; attribution confidence is limited by unavailable local git provenance.
